The issuer shows very weak profitability, with both net income (-892M) and EBIT (-287M) negative, indicating poor operating cash generation capacity. While liquidity appears solid (current ratio ~2.3x) and the equity base provides some balance-sheet cushion, the combination of leverage (liabilities ~70% of assets) and continued losses points to elevated credit risk consistent with a speculative-grade profile.  

DECISION: B+
